{{Quote|We can't allow that. Possession of Outbound Flight by any one Family could destroy the balance of power for decades to come."''<br />''"We'll have to stall him. We must keep his people off this vessel until the Defense Fleet units I've summoned can arrive.|[[Syndic/Legends|Syndic]] [[Mitth'ras'safis/Legends|Mitth'ras'safis]] and Admiral Ar'alani|<ref name="Outbound Flight" />}}
A '''task force''' served as part of [[Chiss Ascendancy/Legends|Chiss Ascendancy's]] [[Chiss Defense Fleet|Defense Fleet]]<ref name="Outbound Flight" /> by [[27 BBY/Legends|27 BBY]].<ref name="ERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of [[Outbound Flight (novel)|''Outbound Flight'']] to [[27 BBY/Legends|27 BBY]].</ref> The [[Task force/Legends|task force]] consisted of [[Cruiser/Legends|Chiss warships]]. Following the [[battle for Outbound Flight]], [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Ar'alani/Legends|Ar'alani]] requested the assistance of this task force for protection, along with other Defense Fleet units.<ref name="Outbound Flight" />
